stem: One genotype performs well with an ex-vitro rooting transition while another performs poorly. What is the strongest program response?
choices: Preserve genotype-specific transition data and avoid forcing one route onto every line
Use the better-performing route for every genotype without validation
Ignore survival because initial roots formed
Pool both genotypes into one average and discard identity
rationale: Genotype-specific transition performance should remain visible because one route may not generalize.
